polityNote: Togo from independence 1960-04-27 to the eve of Loi 81-9 (in force 1981-06-23; from then TGO.json draws the five regions on finer region atoms). Atoms: the prefectures of 2017 (OpenStreetMap via geoBoundaries TGO ADM2, 37 units with Lomé commune separate). Regions are unions of whole circonscriptions (Loi 60-4, Décret 65-148); every prefecture created later was cut from circonscriptions of one region except Sotouboua (1968), which is withheld before 1968. From 1965 the regions were the five « régions économiques » of Décret 65-148, the first level above the circonscriptions. ① Areas (union of atoms / published): Plateaux 1968– (c.1970 16,975; 2015 16,975): 17249/16975 km² = 1.016; Centrale 1968–81 (c.1970): 20270/20450 km² = 0.991; Kara 1965–81 (c.1970): 4562/4362 km² = 1.046; Savanes 1965– (c.1970 8,602): 8698/8602 km² = 1.011; Maritime (c.1970 6,395): 6226/6395 km² = 0.974; Kara 1981– (2015 11,738): 11502/11738 km² = 0.980; Centrale 1981– (2015 13,317): 13329/13317 km² = 1.001; Sotouboua+Blitta+Mô vs Sotouboua circonscription (c.1970): 7686/7490 km² = 1.026; Bassar+Dankpen vs Bassari circonscription (c.1970): 5947/6330 km² = 0.940.
